critical_code_review_comments: command_center.py _cert_section: `expiring = [c for c in valid if str(c.get('expires_at') or '') <= soon]` uses string comparison of ISO timestamps — works because ISO-8601 sorts lexicographically, but only if all timestamps share the same TZ suffix. Safe today (issued_at/expires_at all UTC ISO), but fragile if a producer ever writes a naïve/local timestamp. Consider parsing with datetime.fromisoformat for defensive equality.
routes/command_center_routes.py returns a JSONResponse for evidence-export — good. Consider adding Cache-Control: no-store to prevent proxies caching a hash-chained audit artifact.
CommandCenter.jsx export handler will crash on `report.report_hash.slice(...)` if the API ever returns without report_hash — a minor guard (?.slice) would be cheap insurance.
